name: Relevance AI
desc: Build and deploy a workforce of no-code AI agents
desc_zh: 构建并部署一支无代码 AI 员工队伍，支持多智能体团队协作
solves: A single agent cannot do a job with five steps. Relevance AI lets several no-code agents work one job together.
solves_zh: 单个 Agent 干不完有五步的活。Relevance AI 让多个 no-code Agent 协作完成同一件事。
best_for: When a task has a team shape to it — research, drafting, checking — and nobody wants to write the glue code.
best_for_zh: 当一个任务天然有团队分工的样子——调研、起草、核查——而没人想写胶水代码。
